Meet your English-speaking guide at the airport and transfer to Caracas.

Check in to a Deluxe Standard room at Eurobuilding Hotel Suites Caracas.

After some time to rest, set out on a city tour.

Start in the historic centre at the National Pantheon, where prominent Venezuelans are buried. Its vaulted ceiling is decorated with paintings by Tito Salas depicting the life of Simón Bolívar.

The walk then takes you past the Capitol, which houses two important relics: the Declaration of Independence and Tovar y Tovar's mural of the Battle of Carabobo.

At Plaza Bolívar, see Caracas Cathedral, the former Golden Ounce House, which once housed the royal prison and later the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the municipal building associated with the signing of the Declaration of Independence, and Simón Bolívar's birthplace.

Continue to the modern part of the city to see the El Mirador viewpoint and the Caracas Sphere sculpture.

The next stop is the Los Próceres memorial, dedicated to the heroes of the War of Independence. Walk through the park and see the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, the Walk of Fame and the Plaza of Honour.

Lunch at a traditional restaurant is paid for separately.

If time allows, you can also visit the colonial centre of El Hatillo, a souvenir shop, Plaza Altamira, La Estancia and the La Cruz district.

Caracas: modern towers and city trees beneath a cloudy sky
Canaima, Canaima Lagoon and El Sapo Falls

Early transfer to the airport and flight from Caracas to Canaima National Park.

On arrival, you will be met and pay the **$40** entrance tax before transferring to Waku Lodge, where you will stay in a Standard room.

Enjoy a welcome cocktail, check in and have lunch.

In the afternoon, take a curiara, a traditional Indigenous motorised boat, across Canaima Lagoon.

Four waterfalls feed the lagoon: Acha, Ucaima, Golondrina and Wadaima.

Take a walk on Anatoly Island, named after a Russian explorer who explored the area.

Then walk behind the curtain of El Sapo Falls, between the rock face and the powerful waters of the Carrao River. You can swim in the lagoon if you wish.

On the way back, pass beneath El Acha Falls.

Return to the lodge at sunset.

**Meals:** lunch and dinner.
